steps.title: Squeeze the front brake and check pads
steps.reason: Hand is on the handlebar and brake lever, checking the brake before the bike is moved.

steps.title: Flip quick release open and unwind nut
steps.reason: The bike is turned upside down and the wheel is loosened and free at the fork.

steps.title: Lift the bike and drop the wheel out
steps.reason: The wheel has dropped out of the fork and lies off to the side of the frame.

steps.title: Pull the skewer out of the hub
steps.reason: The skewer and springs are pulled out and held apart from the hub.

steps.title: Spin the wheel and inspect the tire
steps.reason: The wheel has been turned and checked around its full circle, with the bare hub in view.

steps.title: Slide the skewer back through the hub
steps.reason: The skewer is threaded back through the hub with the springs on and held at the wheel.

steps.title: Lower the fork onto the axle
steps.reason: The wheel is seated in the fork ends and the bike is about to be tightened.

steps.title: Snug the nut and close the lever
steps.reason: The lever is closed and the hand is pressing it flat along the fork.

steps.title: Squeeze the brake and spin the wheel
steps.reason: The bike is upright with the wheel in the fork and the wheel spinning clear of the brake.

boundaries.reason: Hand is on the handlebar and brake lever after the bike is moved into view, checking the brake.
Wheel has dropped out and the fork ends appear empty, with the wheel lying separately.
Skewer is clearly out of the hub and held apart in the hands.
Wheel has been spun and checked, with the bare hub in view.
Skewer is through the hub with its lever on one side and the nut on the other, at the end of the window.
Axle already appears seated in the fork with the wheel centered in the first frame.
Lever is closed and flat along the fork blade, with a hand pressing it.

notes: 'Lift the bike and drop the wheel out' is 4.0 s; the step before it is merged into it
'Lower the fork onto the axle' is 2.2 s; the step before it is merged into it
